source_of_truth: Kuschi service-size corrections. Base recipes remain riviera_data/builtins.json unless explicitly superseded.

rules.base_recipe_source: Use GitHub website recipes as current active recipe base.
rules.portion_locking: Do not invent missing service sizes. Ask Kuschi before locking tapas, canape, plated, buffet or corporate portions.
rules.status_locking: confirmed is locked; needs_confirmation is allowed in normal audit but blocks strict audit; not_recommended is allowed only with a clear reason or note.
rules.premium_garnish_rule: Always call out the optional premium garnish where one exists. Keep the standard garnish practical, and list the premium garnish as an upgrade rather than silently replacing the standard.
rules.dessert_variant_rule: Use normal keys where they are clear. Use plated_dessert, roving_dessert, dessert_buffet and dessert_platter only when a normal savoury key would be confusing.
rules.naming_locking: Use master_variant_keys for normal service variants. Special-purpose keys are allowed only when listed in special_variant_keys and documented with status, note/reason and clear service use.

meatball_naming.note: Use 60 g pre-crumb weight as active standard. 80 g is substantial canape only if explicitly requested. Older mini canape and buffet albondigas drafts are service variants, not separate production recipes.

plated_entree.note: Make separate 50 g plated batch before crumbing.

buffet.portion: 1 arancini per guest service target with 1.3 arancini per guest production allowance
buffet.garnish: Aioli topping with chives as standard garnish. Micro herbs are optional premium finish and must be called out as an upgrade.
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, 1 punnet per 80 guests as optional premium finish.
buffet.note: Use chives as the standard buffet garnish because they hold cleaner than micro herbs and eat better than raw thyme. Thyme can be used in the mix or aioli if wanted, but not as the main raw garnish. Always call out the micro herb premium option.

platter.aioli_service_rule: Depends on hot delivery versus immediate service.
platter.hot_delivery_aioli: Serve aioli separately in ramekin/container to protect texture.
platter.immediate_service_aioli: Aioli can be dotted or piped on top before service.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, 1 punnet per 80 pieces as optional premium finish.
platter.note: For platters, decide aioli placement by service condition: separate for hot delivery/holding, dotted on top for immediate service. Always call out the premium micro herb option.

corporate_boxed.portion: 1 piece per box when part of a mixed lunch or hot box
corporate_boxed.aioli_service_rule: Serve aioli separately for hot delivery or holding; dot or pipe on top only for immediate service.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, 1 punnet per 80 boxes as optional premium finish.
corporate_boxed.note: Use as one component in a mixed corporate lunch or hot box, not as a standalone boxed lunch item. Always call out the premium micro herb option.

buffet.portion: 4 calamari strips + 1 baby octopus per guest service target with 1.2 production allowance
buffet.standard_garnish: deep fried capers and 1 lemon wedge
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, 1 punnet per 80 guests as optional premium finish.
buffet.green_powder_note: Use a restrained green powder finish only when it improves the look and does not make the coating look dusty.
buffet.garnish: Deep fried capers, 1 lemon wedge per guest and optional restrained green herb powder such as dill, chive or spring onion. Premium option: micro herbs.
buffet.note: Buffet standard confirmed. Capers are weighed drained before frying. Aioli is 30 ml per guest. Lemon allowance is 1 wedge per guest, based on 8 wedges per lemon. Green powder is optional at 0.2 g per guest. Always call out the premium micro herb option.

buffet.portion: 1 cutlet per guest service target with 1.2 cutlets per guest production allowance
buffet.rocket_bed: confirmed direction - exact quantity needs confirmation
buffet.standard_garnish: rocket bed with beetroot powder or microgreens
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Microgreens as premium finish when not used as the standard garnish.
buffet.note: No lemon wedge. Use rocket as the bed for the cutlet. Finish with beetroot powder or microgreens. Exact rocket quantity, final garnish choice and emulsion quantity still need confirmation before marking the full buffet variant confirmed.

cocktail.recommendation: Use 60 g for normal canape service. Use 80 g only as substantial canape.

buffet.portion: 2 meatballs per guest service target with 2.3 meatballs per guest production allowance
buffet.garnish: Flat-leaf parsley, shaved Manchego, light lemon zest and good olive oil finish.
buffet.sauce: romesco sugo or smoked paprika passata sauce per menu wording
buffet.hold: Hold covered in sauce in bain marie at 75 C. Exposed meatballs dry quickly.
buffet.note: Use canonical Polpette base. Albondigas is menu wording and service style, not a separate active recipe. Production allowance includes buffet buffer. Bread allowance is 1.5 slices per serve at 1.5 cm thickness. Manchego allowance is 10 g per serve. Garnish allowance is 2 g parsley per serve, 1 lemon zested per 40 serves and 3 ml olive oil per serve.

legacy_mini_canape.portion: 1 mini polpette with glaze or sugo
legacy_mini_canape.note: Merged from beef-polpette-canape older draft. Archive/reference only unless Kuschi deliberately reactivates a mini polpette canape format.

corporate_boxed.portion: not recommended for corporate boxes unless specifically ordered
corporate_boxed.reason: Fish sliders are better held and served as cocktail or tapas items. Use corporate boxed only when the client specifically orders sliders and service timing supports quality.

cannoli.size_rule: Cannoli size stays the same across service styles.

roving_dessert.note: Special roving dessert service; used when cannoli are passed rather than plated or sold as tapas.

plated_dessert.note: Special dessert service key for formal plated dessert use; not part of savoury plated entree/main service.
